::: {.intro-text}
I study YouTube, social media influence, information disorders, and platform effects using data donation, platform data, and survey data.

I am a PhD student at Aarhus University's DATALAB working in computational communication science. My research examines how digital platforms shape public communication, influence, and democratic information environments, with a particular focus on YouTube, social media, the Danish public sphere, and methods for responsibly studying platform behavior at scale.
